title: TicketsToDuplicateJudge
description: Body of POST /v1/decisions (OpenAI Decisions API) as sent by the duplicate judge: the new ticket is the input, and each candidate ticket is one predicate question named by the candidate's ID so answers can be correlated.

questions.description: One predicate per candidate ticket, answered in order.

name.description: The candidate ticket's ID, echoed back on the answer.

instructions.description: The statement to judge, containing the candidate ticket.
